messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for service=\"inference-gateway\" region=\"eu-west1\" — triggered 20s ago. AlertID=PD-87432. Symptoms: sudden jump in 502/504 responses across /v1/* endpoints. Escalation: oncall-uk.

lina: acked. I'm on call, joining. pinging metrics & logs.

sam: seeing a surge of 502 from our auth-proxy-eu upstream; traces show auth-proxy returning 502 to gateway.

lina: grabbing the last deploy info — auth-proxy@2026-03-15T04:45 was rolled 6m ago.

sam: quick debug curl to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl -i -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer test-token\" https://eu-gateway.internal/v1/generate | sed -n '1,120p'
```

sam: response headers include: 502 Bad Gateway and upstream-reset in logs.

infra-bot: Metric snapshot: auth-proxy-eu pods=4 -> 1 crashloop in last 5m, cpu usage 92%, conn queue length spiking, ephemeral socket exhaustion threshold hit. Node pressure on node-pool-eu-1.

oncall-uk: rolling a canary rollback on auth-proxy to previous revision; will run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/auth-proxy -n infra-eu --to-revision=42`.

lina: executing rollback now. Watch the rollout:
```bash
kubectl -n infra-eu rollout status deployment/auth-proxy --watch
```

sam: temporary routing workaround: switching eu traffic to fallback pool (eu-fallback-2) for lower latency routes while we stabilize. Applying route policy: `route set inference-gateway region=eu-west1 -> pool=eu-fallback-2`

lina: warming KV caches on fallback pool and priming auth tokens.

evan: customer impact estimate: ~12% of production requests in EU are 5xx-ing in the 5m window; top affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings. Notifying SEs for corpA and startupB now.

sam: scaling action: `kubectl scale deployment/auth-proxy --replicas=6 -n infra-eu` — autoscaler initially at max for the nodepool. Requesting extra nodes.

infra-bot: Autoscaler event: provisioning new node(s) in gke-eu pool. ETA ~3m. Pod reschedule queued.

lina: rollback completed to rev=42. New pods healthy, passing readiness checks. Monitoring error rate.

sam: error rate dropping — 5xx now ~3.9% (was ~12%). Traces show reduced upstream failures.

oncall-uk: PD handoff note: if we maintain <1% for 15m, we'll consider PD closed. I'll remain available for 30m then handoff.

pagerduty-bot: PD-87432 acknowledged by lina. Current escalation: L1 handled. Next escalation L2 if no stable state in 10m.

lina: adding runbook link & quick commands to the incident: https://runbooks.internal/502-proxy-failures and saving the Kibana query: `status:[500 TO 599] AND service:inference-gateway AND region:eu-west1`

sam: small log snippet from auth-proxy before crash:
```
[2026-03-15T04:47:23Z] error: upstream \"token-service\" returned 503, request_id=abc123, conn_refused
[2026-03-15T04:47:23Z] warn: socket acquire timeout, queue_len=512
```

evan: outreach: SE @corpA notified; we told them we have a mitigation and will follow up in 30m. ops@startupb copied.

lina: post-incident tasks: 1) dig into token-service throttling, 2) evaluate connection pool sizing, 3) add alert for ephemeral socket exhaustion. Owners: lina, sam, infra.

oncall-uk: planning handoff: I'll hand to evan in 20m for the watch window.

evan: acked. I'll monitor dashboards and keep #incidents updated.

incident-bot: PD-87432 status update: mitigated. Error rate stabilizing at ~0.9% over the last 5m. No new crashes reported. Recommend keeping watch for 30m before closure.

lina: agreed — will keep channel open, documenting timeline for postmortem. Closing PD in 30m if no regression :thumbsup:
